title: Eight Sleep night carousel
description: A deep night-sky band (black fading to navy) with a centered heading, then a slider of frosted glass cards: the current one bright in the middle, its neighbours dimmed and cut off by the window edges. Each card holds a small app-screen tile, a title and a sentence. Dots and two round outlined arrow buttons move it with a 0.5s glide; a tiny footnote sits under them. On phones the card is just the tile, with the current title and sentence under it.
notes: dark-scoped; the sky slot is a black-to-navy gradient when empty
one 274×158 tile slot per card (app screens); left empty they are frosted glass tiles
